headline: Double-digit growth persists despite cost pressure
summary_short: Q2 2026 revenue grew 19.7% y/y to about IDR 2.2 trillion. H1 2026 revenue reached IDR 4.59 trillion (+18.2% y/y), with H1 net profit of IDR 938 billion, up 20.7% y/y and net margin of 20.4%.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue was approximately IDR 2.2 trillion, up 19.7% y/y. H1 2026 revenue reached IDR 4.59 trillion, up 18.2% y/y, with H1 net profit of IDR 938 billion, up 20.7% y/y and net margin of 20.4%. Q2 standalone margins: gross 45.9%, EBITDA 27.2%, net profit margin 19.5%. Q2 EPS was 7.37 IDR versus 8.5 IDR the prior quarter (-13.3% q/q). Working capital ran at 27% of sales.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. The company's own H1 2026 press release (avianbrands.com, dated 18 Aug 2026, "Avian Brands Melaju Lebih Cepat di Tengah Tantangan Industri") was located via WebSearch but could not be fetched as parseable text within the run's fetch budget (a related PDF on the same domain also returned unreadable binary content). Figures were instead sourced from wire-service recaps of the same release/earnings call (GuruFocus/Yahoo Finance earnings-call highlights, Kontan, pasardana.id, SWA.co.id) plus the resolver's shard EPS figure (Yahoo earningsChart, IDR). Note: Q2-standalone EPS shows a q/q decline (7.37 vs 8.5 IDR) that is not reconciled against the H1 cumulative net-income growth figures — different period scope (Q2-only vs H1-cumulative) and different source families (Yahoo chart vs press recap), not cross-verified against each other. All monetary figures in IDR (Indonesian Rupiah).
